meta.title: fak product-concept scorecard — durable / real / useful-today
meta._doc: Each row is one fak product concept (a CLAIMS.md '##' section), scored on whether a PERSON can pick it up and use it today. The scorecard cross-checks every row against the real tree (the CLAIMS tag the concept carries, whether the first command's cmd dir + verb resolve, whether the witness/entry paths exist), so the score cannot be gamed by editing data alone. Regenerate the doc: python tools/product_scorecard.py --markdown-dir docs/product-scorecard

managed_context_slos.name: Assumption effect safety
managed_context_slos.detail: Low-confidence and stale assumptions fail closed through AssumptionReport.EffectSafe with sorted action counts.
managed_context_slos.next_action: preserve assumption effect safety and non-bypassable confidence gates

managed_context_slos.name: Context visibility
managed_context_slos.detail: Context evidence splits into known materialized rows with source/view digests, unknown refusals/omissions, and assumed contexts.
managed_context_slos.next_action: preserve operator-visible context split and unpromoted unknown handles

managed_context_slos.name: Pinned-objective reconciliation
managed_context_slos.detail: Pinned objectives survive resets as ObjectivePreserved with identical digests, and detect drift, drops, and corruption.
managed_context_slos.next_action: preserve deterministic objective reconciliation and drift refusal

managed_context_slos.name: Deterministic resets
managed_context_slos.detail: Reset seed and transaction generation is idempotent and replayable, recording seed digests, contributors, and omitted spans.
managed_context_slos.next_action: preserve reset idempotence and replayable transaction auditing

managed_context_slos.name: Budget compliance
managed_context_slos.detail: Token and wall-clock budgets enforce limits across restarts and resets, with rearm tracking and drain reasons.
managed_context_slos.next_action: preserve orthogonal budget envelope accounting across resets

managed_context_slos.name: Query correctness
managed_context_slos.detail: Model-authored PlanQuery matches host PlanCells identically, enforcing budget bounds and faithful elision.
managed_context_slos.next_action: preserve zero-divergence plan query lowering and adaptive defaults

managed_context_slos.name: Cache preservation
managed_context_slos.detail: Warm-prefix descriptors verify byte-identical replayed prefixes across resets and reject diverged or truncated prefixes.
managed_context_slos.next_action: preserve warm-prefix descriptor verification and divergence rejection

managed_context_slos.name: Memory-promotion safety
managed_context_slos.detail: Ephemeral observations never mint promotion records, while durable and bounded facts require explicit or inferred consent.
managed_context_slos.next_action: preserve fail-closed memory promotion gating and audit records
